htmlNormalization.name: netlify-compiled-canonical-dom
htmlNormalization.normalization: Native DOMParser canonical tree: preserve every node type, text, comment, tag name and sorted attribute name/value; canonicalize only same-site href values to path/query/fragment, removing final .html and collapsing final index.html to its directory. Preserve query/fragment. Browser parsing permits attribute quoting/order serialization differences. For the pinned hidden Netlify agent-lead registration form only, expected source consumes netlify/netlify-honeypot and defaults method to post; captured form attributes and all fields remain strict. Raw source/capture hashes remain recorded.

retainedReturns.interpretation: First short polling window observed queued delivery; retained, not treated as a production defect.
Later first-link exchange returned 410 after this challenge had already created a valid operator session. Root left the earlier active session untouched.
First HTML oracle rejected Netlify hidden-form compilation; documented source compilation normalization corrected the oracle with no runtime edit.

limitations: No actual hosted customer creation, onboarding completion, business record mutation, or real-tenant owner workflow was exercised.
Actual hosted authentication and API read passed; browser verification used retained deployed bytes with network intercepted. Hosted authenticated browser interaction was not exercised.
Email delivery means receiving-server acceptance. Gmail inbox placement and recipient reading are unverified.
Natural workers were healthy and idle after publication. Local contention and failure fixtures do not establish live contention behavior.
Phone execution remains OFF. No actual AI/voice call, phone/SMS/calendar provisioning or delivery, number purchase or release, or billing change was made or verified.
No raw token, sign-in link, email body or customer DTO was persisted in reviewed proof. Session revocation returned 200; no post-revocation GET was made.
Acceptance covers the exact bounded release evidence and does not declare all customer service delivery fully automated or production complete.
